versos.hebraico: לְאָדָ֥ם מַֽעַרְכֵי־לֵ֑ב וּ֝מֵיְהוָ֗ה מַעֲנֵ֥ה לָשֽׁוֹן׃

controles.web: The plans of the heart belong to man, but the answer of the tongue is from Yahweh.
controles.kjv: The preparations of the heart in man, and the answer of the tongue, is from the Lord.
controles.livre: Do homem são os planejamentos do coração, mas a reposta da boca vem do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: כָּֽל־דַּרְכֵי־אִ֭ישׁ זַ֣ךְ בְּעֵינָ֑יו וְתֹכֵ֖ן רוּח֣וֹת יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; but Yahweh weighs the motives.
controles.kjv: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; but the Lord weigheth the spirits.
controles.livre: Todos os caminhos do homem são puros aos seus próprios olhos; mas o SENHOR pesa os espíritos.

versos.hebraico: גֹּ֣ל אֶל־יְהוָ֣ה מַעֲשֶׂ֑יךָ וְ֝יִכֹּ֗נוּ מַחְשְׁבֹתֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: Commit your deeds to Yahweh, and your plans shall succeed.
controles.kjv: Commit thy works unto the Lord, and thy thoughts shall be established.
controles.livre: Confia tuas obras ao SENHOR, e teus pensamentos serão firmados.

versos.hebraico: כֹּ֤ל פָּעַ֣ל יְ֭הוָה לַֽמַּעֲנֵ֑הוּ וְגַם־רָ֝שָׁ֗ע לְי֣וֹם רָעָֽה׃

controles.web: Yahweh has made everything for its own end— yes, even the wicked for the day of evil.
controles.kjv: The Lord hath made all things for himself: yea, even the wicked for the day of evil.
controles.livre: O SENHOR fez tudo para seu propósito; e até ao perverso para o dia do mal.

versos.hebraico: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה כָּל־גְּבַהּ־לֵ֑ב יָ֥ד לְ֝יָ֗ד לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶֽה׃

controles.web: Everyone who is proud in heart is an abomination to Yahweh: they shall certainly not be unpunished.
controles.kjv: Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to the Lord: though hand join in hand, he shall not be unpunished.
controles.livre: O SENHOR abomina todo orgulhoso de coração; certamente não ficará impune.

versos.hebraico: בְּחֶ֣סֶד וֶ֭אֱמֶת יְכֻפַּ֣ר עָוֺ֑ן וּבְיִרְאַ֥ת יְ֝הוָ֗ה ס֣וּר מֵרָֽע׃

controles.web: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for. By the fear of Yahweh men depart from evil.
controles.kjv: By mercy and truth iniquity is purged: and by the fear of the Lord men depart from evil.
controles.livre: Com misericórdia e fidelidade a perversidade é reconciliada; e com o temor ao SENHOR se desvia do mal.

versos.hebraico: בִּרְצ֣וֹת יְ֭הוָה דַּרְכֵי־אִ֑ישׁ גַּם־א֝וֹיְבָ֗יו יַשְׁלִ֥ם אִתּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: When a man’s ways please Yahweh, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.
controles.kjv: When a man’s ways please the Lord, he maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him.
controles.livre: Quando os caminhos do homem são agradáveis ao SENHOR, ele faz até seus inimigos terem paz com ele.

versos.hebraico: טוֹב־מְ֭עַט בִּצְדָקָ֑ה מֵרֹ֥ב תְּ֝בוּא֗וֹת בְּלֹ֣א מִשְׁפָּֽט׃

controles.web: Better is a little with righteousness, than great revenues with injustice.
controles.kjv: Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues without right.
controles.livre: Melhor é o pouco com justiça, do que a abundância de rendas com injustiça.

versos.hebraico: לֵ֣ב אָ֭דָם יְחַשֵּׁ֣ב דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וַֽ֝יהוָ֗ה יָכִ֥ין צַעֲדֽוֹ׃

controles.web: A man’s heart plans his course, but Yahweh directs his steps.
controles.kjv: A man’s heart deviseth his way: but the Lord directeth his steps.
controles.livre: O coração do homem planeja seu caminho, mas é o SENHOR que dirige seus passos.

versos.hebraico: קֶ֤סֶם׀ עַֽל־שִׂפְתֵי־מֶ֑לֶךְ בְּ֝מִשְׁפָּ֗ט לֹ֣א יִמְעַל־פִּֽיו׃

controles.web: Inspired judgments are on the lips of the king. He shall not betray his mouth.
controles.kjv: A divine sentence is in the lips of the king: his mouth transgresseth not in judgment.
controles.livre: Nos lábios do rei estão palavras sublimes; sua boca não transgride quando julga.

versos.hebraico: פֶּ֤לֶס׀ וּמֹאזְנֵ֣י מִ֭שְׁפָּט לַֽיהוָ֑ה מַ֝עֲשֵׂ֗הוּ כָּל־אַבְנֵי־כִֽיס׃

controles.web: Honest balances and scales are Yahweh’s; all the weights in the bag are his work.
controles.kjv: A just weight and balance are the Lord’s: all the weights of the bag are his work.
controles.livre: O peso e a balança justos pertencem ao SENHOR; a ele pertencem todos os pesos da bolsa.

versos.hebraico: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת מְ֭לָכִים עֲשׂ֣וֹת רֶ֑שַׁע כִּ֥י בִ֝צְדָקָ֗ה יִכּ֥וֹן כִּסֵּֽא׃

controles.web: It is an abomination for kings to do wrong, for the throne is established by righteousness.
controles.kjv: It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness: for the throne is established by righteousness.
controles.livre: Os reis abominam fazer perversidade, porque com justiça é que se confirma o trono.

versos.hebraico: רְצ֣וֹן מְ֭לָכִים שִׂפְתֵי־צֶ֑דֶק וְדֹבֵ֖ר יְשָׁרִ֣ים יֶאֱהָֽב׃

controles.web: Righteous lips are the delight of kings. They value one who speaks the truth.
controles.kjv: Righteous lips are the delight of kings; and they love him that speaketh right.
controles.livre: Os lábios justos são do agrado dos reis, e eles amam ao que fala palavras direitas.

versos.hebraico: חֲמַת־מֶ֥לֶךְ מַלְאֲכֵי־מָ֑וֶת וְאִ֖ישׁ חָכָ֣ם יְכַפְּרֶֽנָּה׃

controles.web: The king’s wrath is a messenger of death, but a wise man will pacify it.
controles.kjv: The wrath of a king is as messengers of death: but a wise man will pacify it.
controles.livre: A ira do rei é como mensageiros de morte; mas o homem sábio a apaziguará.

versos.hebraico: בְּאוֹר־פְּנֵי־מֶ֥לֶךְ חַיִּ֑ים וּ֝רְצוֹנ֗וֹ כְּעָ֣ב מַלְקֽוֹשׁ׃

controles.web: In the light of the king’s face is life. His favor is like a cloud of the spring rain.
controles.kjv: In the light of the king’s countenance is life; and his favour is as a cloud of the latter rain.
controles.livre: No brilho do rosto do rei há vida; e seu favor é como uma nuvem de chuva tardia.

versos.hebraico: קְֽנֹה־חָכְמָ֗ה מַה־טּ֥וֹב מֵחָר֑וּץ וּקְנ֥וֹת בִּ֝ינָ֗ה נִבְחָ֥ר מִכָּֽסֶף׃

controles.web: How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! Yes, to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.
controles.kjv: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold! and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!
controles.livre: Obter sabedoria é tão melhor do que o ouro! E obter sabedoria é mais excelente do que a prata.

versos.hebraico: מְסִלַּ֣ת יְ֭שָׁרִים ס֣וּר מֵרָ֑ע שֹׁמֵ֥ר נַ֝פְשׁ֗וֹ נֹצֵ֥ר דַּרְכּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil. He who keeps his way preserves his soul.
controles.kjv: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil: he that keepeth his way preserveth his soul.
controles.livre: A estrada dos corretos se afasta do mal; e guarda sua alma quem vigia seu caminho.

versos.hebraico: לִפְנֵי־שֶׁ֥בֶר גָּא֑וֹן וְלִפְנֵ֥י כִ֝שָּׁל֗וֹן גֹּ֣בַהּ רֽוּחַ׃

controles.web: Pride goes before destruction, and a haughty spirit before a fall.
controles.kjv: Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.
controles.livre: Antes da destruição vem a arrogância, e antes da queda vem a soberba de espírito.

versos.hebraico: ט֣וֹב שְׁפַל־ר֭וּחַ אֶת־עניים מֵֽחַלֵּ֥ק שָׁ֝לָ֗ל אֶת־גֵּאִֽים׃

controles.web: It is better to be of a lowly spirit with the poor, than to divide the plunder with the proud.
controles.kjv: Better it is to be of an humble spirit with the lowly, than to divide the spoil with the proud.
controles.livre: É melhor ser humilde de espírito com os mansos, do que repartir despojos com os arrogantes.

versos.hebraico: מַשְׂכִּ֣יל עַל־דָּ֭בָר יִמְצָא־ט֑וֹב וּבוֹטֵ֖חַ בַּיהוָ֣ה אַשְׁרָֽיו׃

controles.web: He who heeds the Word finds prosperity. Whoever trusts in Yahweh is blessed.
controles.kjv: He that handleth a matter wisely shall find good: and whoso trusteth in the Lord, happy is he.
controles.livre: Aquele que pensa prudentemente na palavra encontrará o bem; e quem confia no SENHOR é bem-aventurado.

versos.hebraico: לַחֲכַם־לֵ֭ב יִקָּרֵ֣א נָב֑וֹן וּמֶ֥תֶק שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם יֹסִ֥יף לֶֽקַח׃

controles.web: The wise in heart shall be called prudent. Pleasantness of the lips promotes instruction.
controles.kjv: The wise in heart shall be called prudent: and the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning.
controles.livre: O sábio de coração será chamado de prudente; e a doçura dos lábios aumentará a instrução.

versos.hebraico: מְק֣וֹר חַ֭יִּים שֵׂ֣כֶל בְּעָלָ֑יו וּמוּסַ֖ר אֱוִלִ֣ים אִוֶּֽלֶת׃

controles.web: Understanding is a fountain of life to one who has it, but the punishment of fools is their folly.
controles.kjv: Understanding is a wellspring of life unto him that hath it: but the instruction of fools is folly.
controles.livre: Manancial de vida é o entendimento, para queles que o possuem; mas a instrução dos tolos é loucura.

versos.hebraico: לֵ֣ב חָ֭כָם יַשְׂכִּ֣יל פִּ֑יהוּ וְעַל־שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו יֹסִ֥יף לֶֽקַח׃

controles.web: The heart of the wise instructs his mouth, and adds learning to his lips.
controles.kjv: The heart of the wise teacheth his mouth, and addeth learning to his lips.
controles.livre: O coração do sábio dá prudência à sua boca; e sobre seus lábios aumentará a instrução.

versos.hebraico: צוּף־דְּ֭בַשׁ אִמְרֵי־נֹ֑עַם מָת֥וֹק לַ֝נֶּפֶשׁ וּמַרְפֵּ֥א לָעָֽצֶם׃

controles.web: Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
controles.kjv: Pleasant words are as an honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
controles.livre: Favo de mel são as palavras suaves: doces para a alma, e remédio para os ossos.

versos.hebraico: יֵ֤שׁ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יָ֭שָׁר לִפְנֵי־אִ֑ישׁ וְ֝אַחֲרִיתָ֗הּ דַּרְכֵי־מָֽוֶת׃

controles.web: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.
controles.kjv: There is a way that seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.
controles.livre: Há um caminho que parece direito ao homem, porém seu fim são caminhos de morte.

versos.hebraico: נֶ֣פֶשׁ עָ֭מֵל עָ֣מְלָה לּ֑וֹ כִּֽי־אָכַ֖ף עָלָ֣יו פִּֽיהוּ׃

controles.web: The appetite of the laboring man labors for him; for his mouth urges him on.
controles.kjv: He that laboureth laboureth for himself; for his mouth craveth it of him.
controles.livre: A alma do trabalhador faz ele trabalhar para si, porque sua boca o obriga.

versos.hebraico: אִ֣ישׁ בְּ֭לִיַּעַל כֹּרֶ֣ה רָעָ֑ה וְעַל־שפתיו כְּאֵ֣שׁ צָרָֽבֶת׃

controles.web: A worthless man devises mischief. His speech is like a scorching fire.
controles.kjv: An ungodly man diggeth up evil: and in his lips there is as a burning fire.
controles.livre: O homem maligno cava o mal, e em seus lábios há como que um fogo ardente.

versos.hebraico: אִ֣ישׁ תַּ֭הְפֻּכוֹת יְשַׁלַּ֣ח מָד֑וֹן וְ֝נִרְגָּ֗ מַפְרִ֥יד אַלּֽוּף׃

controles.web: A perverse man stirs up strife. A whisperer separates close friends.
controles.kjv: A froward man soweth strife: and a whisperer separateth chief friends.
controles.livre: O homem perverso levanta contenda, e o difamador faz até grandes amigos se separarem.

versos.hebraico: אִ֣ישׁ חָ֭מָס יְפַתֶּ֣ה רֵעֵ֑הוּ וְ֝הוֹלִיכ֗וֹ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ לֹא־טֽוֹב׃

controles.web: A man of violence entices his neighbor, and leads him in a way that is not good.
controles.kjv: A violent man enticeth his neighbour, and leadeth him into the way that is not good.
controles.livre: O homem violento ilude a seu próximo, e o guia por um caminho que não é bom.

versos.hebraico: עֹצֶ֣ה עֵ֭ינָיו לַחְשֹׁ֣ב תַּהְפֻּכ֑וֹת קֹרֵ֥ץ שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו כִּלָּ֥ה רָעָֽה׃

controles.web: One who winks his eyes to plot perversities, one who compresses his lips, is bent on evil.
controles.kjv: He shutteth his eyes to devise froward things: moving his lips he bringeth evil to pass.
controles.livre: Ele fecha seus olhos para imaginar perversidades; ele aperta os lábios para praticar o mal.

versos.hebraico: עֲטֶ֣רֶת תִּפְאֶ֣רֶת שֵׂיבָ֑ה בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ צְ֝דָקָ֗ה תִּמָּצֵֽא׃

controles.web: Gray hair is a crown of glory. It is attained by a life of righteousness.
controles.kjv: The hoary head is a crown of glory, if it be found in the way of righteousness.
controles.livre: Cabelos grisalhos são uma coroa de honra, caso se encontrem no caminho de justiça.

versos.hebraico: ט֤וֹב אֶ֣רֶךְ אַ֭פַּיִם מִגִּבּ֑וֹר וּמֹשֵׁ֥ל בְּ֝רוּח֗וֹ מִלֹּכֵ֥ד עִֽיר׃

controles.web: One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty; one who rules his spirit, than he who takes a city.
controles.kjv: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.
controles.livre: Melhor é o que demora para se irritar do que o valente; e melhor é aquele que domina seu espírito do que aquele que toma uma cidade.

versos.hebraico: בַּ֭חֵיק יוּטַ֣ל אֶת־הַגּוֹרָ֑ל וּ֝מֵיְהוָ֗ה כָּל־מִשְׁפָּטֽוֹ׃

controles.web: The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from Yahweh.
controles.kjv: The lot is cast into the lap; but the whole disposing thereof is of the Lord.
controles.livre: A sorte é lançada no colo, mas toda decisão pertence ao SENHOR.
